name: appwrite
description: The open-source cloud for agents & devs. Including Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Messaging, Hosting, Realtime, WAF and more
readme: Appwrite The open-source cloud for agents and developers. Appwrite is an MCP and agent-first platform for building and scaling apps. Give your agents Auth, Databases, Storage, Functions, Messaging, Realtime, and Hosting, all in one place. Appwrite is an MCP and agent-first, open-source platform for building and scaling apps. MCP is included, so coding agents can operate on a live Appwrite project. Appwrite is available as a managed cloud platform and can also be self-hosted on infrastructure you control.
